parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: 快照ID。取值：极速型NAS高级型成功创建快照[CreateSnapshot](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createsnapshot?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-27516.d_0)后，使用[DescribeSnapshots](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describesnapshots?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-27516.d_0)（传入 FileSystemType=extreme）查询快照列表，获得快照ID。
